jobs.title: Student worker - Business Intelligence
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

**Could you see yourself take part in a high performing global organization within Engineering that lead projects and engineering development of technologies platforms and systems where you will make an IMPACT?**

Buckle up and get yourself energized for a student worker journey, full of development opportunities within a global engineering organization. Bring out your sharpest analytical instruments, find your inner data driven spirit, pack-up your best communication skills and get your playful groove on to take the role as student worker within Manufacturing Design and Implementation**.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Analyze and visualize data within the logistics area of responsibility
* Build Power BI reports
* Build argumentation and presentations of findings
* Dialogue with global specialists
* Stakeholder management
* Ad hoc on data analytics and business intelligence support

**Play your part in our team succeeding**

The overall objective of MD&I is owner of global platform technologies that enables the manufacturing and logistics of bricks and material. Furthermore, we lead the complete factory layouts covering Moulding, Logistic, Pack & Processing, and to ensure global alignment of these.

Purpose of this position is to support the team by finding the right data for projects, tasks, focus areas and justifications. Furthermore to do general presentations and documentation of analysis and results.

**Do you have what it takes?**

* Bachelor’s degree in a business- or IT-related field or equivalent working experience
* Advanced Excel skills
* Data visualization understanding and skills
* Analytical and structured
* Self-driven
* Proactive, thoughrough and curious
* Friendly nature with good understanding of a diverse international organization.
* Strong communicative skills are a must – fluent English.
* Well-structured with strong planning and coordination talent.
* Strong attention to detail is critical.
* Good collaboration skills and a “can-do” attitude is essential.
* Person must thrive juggling multiple tasks in a dynamic environment with many stakeholders, have a good sense of humor and an accommodating personality.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:

**Family Care Leave** - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

**Wellbeing** - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

**Bonus** - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Your workplace:** Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.

**Hybrid Working:** Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience [here](https://www.lego.com/careers/why-join-us)

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

jobs.title: Studentermedarbejder i Business Banking DK
jobs.description_md:
# Studentermedarbejder i Business Banking DK

København S, DK, 2300

**Job ID: 7222**

Vi søger en selvstændig og engageret studentermedarbejder, som kan blive en del af vores team i Business Banking DK Office, hvor du vil være med til at levere support til vores lederteam, koordinere og eksekvere på interne og eksterne arrangementer og deltage i initiativer for at styrke vores forretning.   

**Om vores team**

Velkommen til Business Banking Danmark, hvor vi er ansvarlige for små og mellemstore virksomheder. Vores kunder bliver serviceret af vores dygtige rådgivere, understøttet af kompetente kreditspecialister, produktspecialister, supportfunktioner over hele landet samt Nordea Business Center (NBC).

BB DK Office er tæt på både beslutningerne og eksekveringen i Business Banking Danmark. Vi understøtter ledelsen med centrale ledelsesprocesser og skaber samtidig struktur, fremdrift og eksekvering på strategiske og tværgående agendaer.

**Det skal du arbejde med**

* Supportere ledelsen og Business Banking DK med administrative opgaver og opbygge god forståelse for interne systemer (fx fakturahåndtering og HR-systemer)
* Planlægge, koordinere og eksekvere på både interne og eksterne begivenheder og arrangementer
* Løse opgaver og deltage i initiativer af forskellig karakter, ofte i samarbejde med stakeholdere.
* Sikre overblik og struktur i opfølgning

**Hvem du er**

**For at blive succesfuld i rollen forventer vi, at du;**

* Er serviceminded, nysgerrig og proaktiv
* Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og analytisk
* Er god til at samarbejde med stakeholders i flere forskellige dele af organisationen
* Stort kendskab til MS Office-værktøjer og er tryg ved at tage nye teknologier og applikationer i brug
* Er stærk i skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation og flydende på dansk og engelsk
* Studerer på universitetet, gerne på 2. eller 3 studieår

Rollen er med base på vores hovedkontor (Metro) i København.

**Det tilbyder vi**

Vores nye kolleger kommer til os, når de ønsker at udvikle sig. For nogle er det næste skridt på vejen i deres karriere. For andre er det at sætte nye mål inden for deres ekspertiseområde – med andre ord, hos os kommer du altid videre.

En kultur, der fremmer præstation og vækst i en af de største nordiske banker, som tilbyder forskellige muligheder for at udfolde sig, udvikle sig og lære af dygtige kolleger med forskellig baggrund i et levende arbejdsmiljø.

Hybrid arbejdsmodel – vi tror på værdien af at føre mennesker sammen, og samtidig vælger vi friheden ved at være fleksible.

Mangfoldighed og inklusion er en naturlig del af vores daglige arbejde. Vi ved, at en inkluderende arbejdsplads er bæredygtig. Vi tror oprigtigt på, at vores forskellige baggrunde, erfaringer, egenskaber og personligheder gør os stærkere sammen. Hver dag stræber vi efter at finde nye måder at forbedre mangfoldighed og inklusion i vores netværk på, f.eks. har vi underskrevet mangfoldighedschartre under EU-Kommissionen i de lande, hvor vi driver virksomhed, for at understrege vores villighed til at engagere os med andre for at fortsætte med at lære og forbedre os.

Hvis dette lyder som dig, så kontakt os!

**De næste trin**

Lyder dette som dig, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest den 23/11/2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of BB DK Office, Caroline Gammelgaard, på caroline.gammelgaard@nordea.com. Der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende.

**Rekrutteringsprocessen består af følgende trin:**

* Foreløbig udvælgelse af CV
* Interview med den ansættende leder
* Baggrunds- og referencertjek

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

Vi opbygger relationer. Vi sætter et personligt præg på alt, hvad vi gør – når vi rådgiver vores kunder, samarbejder med kolleger og møder vores potentielle kandidater.

Vi lærer og udvikler os. Vi sætter en ære i at være eksperter og tænke fremad. Vi anvender vores ekspertise til at imødekomme vores kunders behov, fra de enkleste til de mest komplekse. Vi har en tankegang om vækst i vores arbejde, der gør det muligt for os at fokusere bredere i vores daglige udfordringer.

Vi står i spidsen for forandring. Vi er ansvarlige og bevidste om virkningen af vores beslutninger, både for vores kunder og for vores lokale og globale samfund. Vi er opmærksomme på vores ansvar over for nuværende og fremtidige generationer og har gjort bæredygtighed til en integreret del af vores forretningsstrategi.

Vi er Nordea. Vi har 200 års historie med at støtte og få de nordiske økonomier til at vokse, og vores værdier er dybt forankret i disse åbne, progressive og samarbejdsvillige samfund. Som en af de største arbejdsgivere i Norden, Polen og Estland har du gode muligheder for at udfolde dig, udvikle dig og komme videre med os.

Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products

Would you like to put your studies into practice in an AI-first engineering environment and work with data engineering and AI-assisted development that creates real business value? Would you like to build your technical skills while contributing to solutions used across Nykredit? Then you might be our new Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products.

As a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products, you will play an important role in our team, helping us build reports, automate processes and develop the data flows and platforms that support fund valuation, alternatives and fund accounting.

Nykredit is investing heavily in AI, and our team takes an AI-first approach. We actively consider how AI can help us code, test and solve problems more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the results.

You will also become part of the Nykredit Group, where we offer opportunities and development for those who are curious and eager to learn. Through our student network, Nykredit Youth, you will be invited to professional events and networking opportunities with other students and young colleagues across the Group.

Are you motivated by data engineering and new technologies?
Then you have come to the right place. Your focus will be on reports, data processing, event-driven streaming pipelines and the platforms supporting our business domains.

You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, Azure and Kafka, alongside colleagues using GitHub, Terraform and Grafana for development, deployment and monitoring. These are technologies you will have the opportunity to work with and learn about, not a checklist of things you need to know before applying.

Your tasks will include:

Developing and improving reports used by the business.
Preparing, transforming and validating financial data.
Automating manual tasks using Python and SQL.
Helping build and test event-driven streaming pipelines and integrations using Kafka.Working with SimCorp Dimension and bringing its data into our Wealth Data Hub.
Improving monitoring and automation of data flows and operational tasks.
Exploring how AI can help us modernise legacy code, automate operations and improve data quality.
Investigating data quality issues and improving existing solutions.

You will start with well-defined tasks and gradually take on more responsibility as you learn, working alongside experienced engineers on real deliveries.

The position is 10–15 hours per week at our headquarters, Nykredit Huset, Sundkrogsgade 25 in Nordhavn, where most of the team is based.

AI as part of your everyday work
We work with an AI-first approach: when tackling a task, we actively consider how AI can help us solve it better and more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the result.

You will get hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools and platforms for coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Together with experienced colleagues, you will explore how AI can help modernise legacy code, automate repetitive work and improve data quality.

We encourage you to experiment and bring your own ideas while learning to understand, review and validate AI-generated output. You do not need experience with specific AI tools before joining us. We will help you get started.

Are you the one we are looking for?
We imagine that you:

are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field,
have some experience with Python and SQL from coursework, personal projects or a previous student job,
enjoy solving problems and working carefully with data,
are comfortable asking questions and sharing what you learn,
are curious about AI-assisted development and keen to use it in practice,
are willing to experiment with AI while questioning, reviewing and understanding the output and code you work with. 

We know you are still studying, so we do not expect you to know everything from day one. No financial background is needed, and familiarity with Git, cloud platforms or reporting projects is useful but not required.

What matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn alongside experienced colleagues. In your application, we would therefore like to hear about a project or assignment you have worked on, how you approached it and what you learned.

Your new team
You will join Fund Accounting Products in Nykredit Wealth Technology, where engineers and specialists work closely with the business.

We are modernising our solutions through the re-implementation of SimCorp Dimension, new SaaS solutions and the replacement of existing in-house systems. You will contribute to both existing solutions and new deliveries, with guidance from experienced colleagues and opportunities to learn how financial requirements translate into working code and reliable data.

We look forward to welcoming you as our new colleague.

Want to know more?
You are welcome to contact Development Manager Søren Valther Rasmussen at +45 44 55 51 42 if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Bliv studentermedhjælper i ServiceNow teamet

Er du motiveret for at sikre datakvalitet og skabe overblik? Vil du være med til at modne CMDB-data på tværs af vores centrale ServiceNow-platform? Og vil du være en del af en af landets største finansielle institutioner – med et stort unge/studenternetværk? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Som studentermedhjælper i ServiceNow teamet spiller du en vigtig rolle i vores team, der har ansvaret for ServiceNow i Nykredit-koncernen. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med funktionschefen for ServiceNow og en af vores dygtige seniorspecialister. Sammen sikrer I et solidt datagrundlag, der skaber værdi for forretningen.

Du bliver også en del af Nykredit-koncernen, hvor vi bl.a. lover muligheder og udvikling til dig, der vil og kan. Det vil du også opleve gennem fx vores unge/studenternetværk, Nykredit Youth. Her bliver du løbende inviteret til faglige oplæg med fx vores egne direktionsmedlemmer som oplægsholdere samt arrangementer, hvor du får mulighed for at netværke med andre unge fra hele koncernen.

Motiveres du af datamodeller, kvalitet og bred kontaktflade på tværs af IT?
Så er du landet rigtigt. Som studentermedhjælper hos os kan du se frem til at arbejde med:

Analyse, modning og løbende sikring af høj datakvalitet i Nykredits CMDB.
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af rapportering og dashboards til synliggørelse af data.
At drive selvstændige, individuelle datarelaterede opgaver fra start til slut.
At kommunikere og sparre med IT-interessenter for at opnå fælles forståelse for datamodeller, processer og ejerskab.

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt ca. 15 timer om ugen. Arbejdsstedet er Aalborg.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, data eller forretningsudvikling, og at du:

har en naturlig flair for datamodeller og databehandling,
er kommunikativt dygtig og forstår at formidle komplekse budskaber tydeligt til forskellige interessenter,
er selvkørende, proaktiv og trives med selv at tage ansvar for at drive dine opgaver fremad,
måske har kendskab til ServiceNow, ITSM eller ITIL (dette er et plus, men ikke et krav).

Dit nye team

jobs.description_md:
## Quote

You’ll gain hands-on experience and insight into the energy markets that go beyond what you learn in the classroom. Along the way, you’ll help create solutions that enable our customers to grow their businesses.

## Here’s what the job entails

As our new Junior Commercial Asset Manager, you will support our Commercial Asset Management and Origination teams, with a particular focus on Italian customers within renewables assets. You will contribute to a variety of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience with the European energy markets. A key part of the role is also to engage with stakeholders, build relations and navigate across the entire organisation.

Furthermore, your responsibilities include:

* handling contract management and preparing tender and sales material
* joining customer meetings and contributing to solutions that support customer growth
* supporting planning, execution, and participation of commercial events, conferences and fairs
* collaborating closely with middle and back-office teams
* driving and participating in internal projects

The position is based in Copenhagen, alternatively Aarhus.

## Meet your team

You will join our Commercial Asset Management team, dedicated to optimising Danske Commodities’ customer-related activities in Europe. The team collaborates closely with our Origination sales team to grow our customer business by for instance drafting contracts, managing tender processes and driving business development.

We share a deep understanding of energy markets and what our customers need. We keep an informal tone, and we believe teamwork is key to success. As a diverse team of market specialists across various European offices, nationalities and backgrounds, we bring together different perspectives to create real impact.

## But enough about us… over to you!

As you will work on a variety of tasks and collaborate with different people across the organisation, we imagine that you are curious, structured and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You enjoy working with others and find energy in supporting customers and colleagues.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

* are enrolled in a relevant education within Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Energy Economics or similar
* are curious about energy markets and motivated to learn more
* can work approximately 15-20 hours a week
* are proficient in Italian and English – both written and spoken. If you speak any additional languages, we would love to hear about them

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

## We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

**Shape your development** tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

**100+ yearly events** from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

**Global career paths** as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

**Flexible work life**to fit with your studies

**Unlimited paid child’s sick days**because family comes first

**Free tickets & discounts**culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

**Organic meals** light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

…. and much more

jobs.title: Student Assistant, Netcompany's Service Desk
jobs.description_md:
*Are you motivated by delivering great service and support, and do you want to develop your skills within IT operations, communication, and service delivery? If so, you now have the opportunity to build valuable experience alongside your studies as a Student Service Desk Assistant at Netcompany Service Desk.*

**Responsibilities and technologies**

As a Student Service Desk Assistant at Netcompany Service Desk, you will take on a student job that supports both your personal and professional development. You will gain solid experience within IT operations, technical support, and communication with both internal and external stakeholders.

You will become part of a team consisting of both full-time employees and student assistants, where shifts are distributed among the student staff. Your tasks will primarily relate to monitoring and incident escalation.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

* Monitoring IT systems and services.
* Acting as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, mainly via phone.
* Logging, tracking, and escalating incidents.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and procedures.

Your shifts will be scheduled between 17:00–07:00 on weekdays and may also include 24/7 coverage during weekends and public holidays. You should therefore be prepared to work evenings, nights, and weekends. Shifts are planned according to a fixed schedule so you will always know when you are expected to work.

As part of your onboarding and training, your initial shifts will take place during daytime hours to ensure you are properly prepared to handle responsibilities outside normal working hours.

**About you**

To succeed in this role, you:

* Are currently enrolled in a higher education IT program.
* Have a broad understanding of IT, preferably with an interest in Windows or Linux environments.
* Are motivated, curious, and independent, with a desire to learn how an operation organization functions.
* Are comfortable working night shifts and weekend schedules.
* Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us**
At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community**

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application**
Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

*All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.*

*We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.* *#LI-SA1*

We are partnering with CBS AI to invite students from CBS for an evening at the Accenture Copenhagen office, where we explore how AI is shaping the future of consulting - both in how we work and in the solutions, we deliver to clients.

jobs.description_md:
# Student Assistant - Netto IT Support

## Student Assistant - Netto IT Support

**Student Assistant – Netto IT Support**

Har du flair for IT, et naturligt servicegen og lyst til et studiejob, hvor du gør en forskel hver eneste dag? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Netto søger vi en engageret studentermedhjælper til vores IT Support på hovedkontoret i Køge. Her får du mulighed for at omsætte din IT-interesse til praktisk erfaring i en spændende og alsidig hverdag, hvor ingen dage nødvendigvis er ens.

Som en del af Salling Group har Netto mere end 500 butikker i Danmark, og bag den daglige drift står blandt andet vores IT-afdeling, der er med til at sikre, at teknologien fungerer, så vores kolleger kan koncentrere sig om det vigtigste: At skabe gode oplevelser for vores kunder.

**Bliv en del af holdet bag driften**

Du bliver en del af en IT-afdeling med 18 engagerede kolleger fordelt på IT Support, IT Drift og IT-projekter.

I IT Support er vi en vigtig samarbejdspartner for vores butikker, administration og lagre. Vi hjælper, når teknologien driller, finder løsninger og sikrer, at vores kolleger hurtigt kan komme videre med deres arbejde.

Vi har høje ambitioner, en uformel omgangstone og en fælles stolthed over at levere kompetent og professionel service – også når tempoet er højt.

**Dine opgaver – variation, ansvar og masser af læring**

Som vores nye studentermedhjælper bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige IT-support, hvor du blandt andet skal:

* Yde telefonisk IT-support til vores butikker, administrationen i Køge og vores to lagre.
* Hjælpe med fejlfinding og support på de forskellige IT-systemer, som anvendes i vores butikker.
* Håndtere og følge op på henvendelser, så vores kolleger får den hjælp, de har brug for.
* Bidrage til forskellige ad hoc-opgaver i afdelingen.

Du behøver ikke kende alle svarene på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, har lyst til at lære og motiveres af at finde løsninger, der gør hverdagen lettere for andre.

**Hvem er du?**

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en uddannelse og har en naturlig interesse for IT og teknologi. Måske har du allerede erfaring med IT-support, måske er du bare typen, som venner og familie ringer til, når teknikken driller.

For os er din tilgang og motivation mindst lige så vigtig som din erfaring.

Vi håber, at du:

* Har en god IT-forståelse og lyst til at udvikle dine kompetencer.
* Er serviceminded, tålmodig og god til at kommunikere med forskellige mennesker.
* Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når flere opgaver kræver din opmærksomhed.
* Arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.
* Taler og skriver flydende dansk.
* Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider.

Har du erfaring fra detailhandlen – og måske endda fra Netto – er det en klar fordel, da du allerede har forståelse for den hverdag, vi understøtter. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Og så håber vi naturligvis, at du bidrager med godt humør, engagement og lysten til at være en del af fællesskabet.

**Hvad får du hos os?**

Du får mere end bare et studiejob. Du får mulighed for at opbygge praktisk erfaring med IT-support i en stor organisation, hvor dine opgaver har direkte betydning for mange menneskers arbejdsdag.

Vi tilbyder dig:

* Et spændende og alsidigt studiejob på 13 timer om ugen med mulighed for ekstra timer i travle perioder.
* Praktisk erfaring med IT-systemer, support og problemløsning.
* Et engageret team med dygtige kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og deler deres viden.
* En hverdag med ansvar, udviklingsmuligheder og plads til at stille spørgsmål.
* En uformel kultur, hvor vi arbejder seriøst med vores opgaver, men også har plads til et godt grin.
* Attraktive personaleforhold som en del af Salling Group.

**Arbejdstid og arbejdssted**

Din arbejdsplads bliver på Nettos hovedkontor i Køge.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt 13 timer om ugen og vil være fordelt på skiftende vagter mellem kl. 06.30 og 18.00. Du skal være indstillet på, at arbejdet også omfatter weekender og helligdage, da vores support skal være tilgængelig, når butikkerne har brug for os.

**Er du klar til at gøre en forskel bag kulisserne?**

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Team Leader Stine Ulfkjær Johansen på telefon 87 78 73 43.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send os gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

**Ansøgningsfrist: 30. november 2026**

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye kollega velkommen på holdet!

# Studerende til kundeservice - din chance for at få relevant erfaring i en bank!

Coop Bank A/S

Albertslund

Er du klar til et spændende studiejob, hvor du kan kombinere dit studie med praktisk erfaring i en bank.

Coop Bank søger en engageret studerende til kundeserviceteamet, som har minimum 2 år tilbage af studiet.

Kundeservice er bankens hjerte, og her vil du møde vores kunder primært på telefonen men også via mail/netbank. Med ca. 15 timer om ugen er det et perfekt job for dig, der brænder for kundeservice og bank, samtidig med at du kan passe dit studie.

Du kommer til at indgå i en travl hverdag med søde, dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger, der vægter samarbejde og feedback.

Banken er fleksibel med vagter i forhold til dit studie og eksaminer. Og skal du i praktik i forbindelse med eks. dit finansstudie så vil der være mulighed for at afvikle praktikperioden i banken, dog tidligst fra januar 2028.

Arbejdstiden vil ligge på hverdage mellem kl. 8.30 og 17.00. Der kan dog i spidsbelastningsperioder primært omkring den 1. i måneden være mulighed for weekend eller aftenarbejde.

## Hvad indebærer jobbet?

Som en del af vores kundeserviceteam får du mulighed for at:

**Tale med kunder**: Du vil besvare opkald og proaktivt hjælpe kunderne med alt fra NemKonto, netbank og mobilbank til lån og kreditter.

**Skabe værdi**: Gennem samtaler skal du gøre kunderne opmærksomme på de mange ydelser, vi tilbyder kunderne i Coop Bank.

**Lære og udvikle dig**: Du får grundig oplæring og opbygger en bred viden om bankens produkter, så du kan levere service af højeste kvalitet til kunderne.

## Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

* er en glad og smilende person med godt humør, som elsker at have travlt og tale med mennesker.
* studerer Finansøkonom, Finansbachelor eller anden relevant uddannelse, og har min. 2 år tilbage af din uddannelse.
* er fleksibel og kan arbejde hele eller halve hverdage mellem kl. 8.30 og 17.00 (med mulighed for aften- og weekendvagter i spidsbelastningsperioder).

## Hvorfor Coop Bank?

Vi er en ambitiøs digital bank, hvor alle kender hinanden og hjælper hinanden. Her er nogle grunde til, at du skal vælge os:

**Fleksibilitet**: Vi tilpasser arbejdstider, så de passer til dine eksamener, da vi ved, at din uddannelse har førsteprioritet.

**God stemning**: Vi værdsætter et positivt arbejdsmiljø og har fokus på teamwork samt på den gode kundeoplevelse og ikke mindst på at skabe merværdi for kunderne!

**Læring**: Du får et unikt indblik i bankens produkter og processer og vil være en del af et team, der virkelig engagerer sig i at løfte hinanden.

**Timelønnen:** udgør 201,94 kr. inkl. pension og hertil kommer løbende udbetaling af 6. ferieuge og omsorgsdage samt feriegodtgørelse og årlig udbetaling af ekstra overenskomstferietillæg på 2,25 %.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning til [job@coopbank.dk](mailto:job@coopbank.dk) og bliv en del af Coop Bank-familien!

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
